sub_sector.value: Convenient protein nutrition; sports performance nutrition

product_category.detail: Ready-to-drink protein shakes, protein powders, sparkling protein soda, and sports nutrition products.

market_position.detail: Premier Protein reaches mass and club shoppers, while Dymatize serves premium performance nutrition.

distribution_model.detail: Sold through food, drug, mass, convenience, club, specialty, e-commerce, and foodservice channels.

purchase_frequency.detail: Consumers replenish protein shakes and powders for convenient nutrition, strength, and muscle recovery.

notes: Purchase frequency is inferred from the products’ role in ongoing nutrition and training routines.
